responsibility: This file is the core buffered file I/O implementation for the mc-boot runtime. It owns the file descriptor table, per-file status and usage state, filename metadata, buffering structures, standard stream handles, and operations for opening, closing, buffered and direct reads/writes, unread, line and string I/O, binary cardinal transfers, file-position control, and filename lookup, using Indexing to manage active file descriptors and libc system calls underneath; it is the main file abstraction layer on which higher-level IO, SFIO, and lexer-style input code depend.
same_name_distinction: Implements the buffered file subsystem declared in GFIO.h: it defines the concrete file-descriptor, filename, and buffer data structures, owns the global file table and standard stream objects, and performs the actual libc/read/write/lseek operations and initialization/finalization logic.
